# Allure

> Allure is a leading beauty and lifestyle media destination offering curated product recommendations, expert beauty routines, video tutorials, and exclusive newsletters from renowned editors and beauty experts.

Allure provides comprehensive beauty coverage through multiple channels including editor-curated picks, video content, newsletter subscriptions, and beauty box unboxings. The site features contributions from top beauty editors and celebrates diverse beauty traditions across brands like Sephora, Ulta Beauty, and Nordstrom.

## Key Topics

- Beauty Editor Picks
- Product Recommendations
- Skincare
- Beauty Routines
- Newsletters
- The Melanin Edit
- Beauty Box
- Video Tutorials
- Celebrity Interviews
- Cosmetics
- Makeup
- Hair Care
- Beauty Products
- Editorial Content
- Email Subscriptions

## Editor Beauty Collections

- [Jessica Cruel's Beauty Edit](https://www.allure.com/jessica-cruel-beauty-edit): Editor-in-chief's high-maintenance routine with black-owned beauty brands
- [Sarah Kinonen's Beauty Edit](https://www.allure.com/sarah-kinonen-beauty-edit): Editor-curated beauty picks featuring skincare and SPF essentials
- [Dianna Mazzone Singh's Beauty Edit](https://www.allure.com/dianna-mazzone-singh-beauty-edit): Associate features director's luxury cosmetics and makeup recommendations
- [Ingrid Fowler's Beauty Edit](https://www.allure.com/ingrid-fowler-beauty-edit): Minimalist beauty routine with mascara and lip care essentials
- [Bianca Richard's Beauty Edit](https://www.allure.com/bianca-richards-beauty-edit): Curated hair and skincare picks celebrating Latina beauty traditions
- [Kassidy Silva's Beauty Edit](https://www.allure.com/kassidy-silva-beauty-edit): Meticulously selected beauty routine from hair tools to makeup
- [Angela Trakoshis' Beauty Edit](https://www.allure.com/ang-trakoshis-beauty-edit): Shopping editor's curated picks balancing deals and luxury splurges
